title: Curb fix + carpools at Del Norte
pitch: Six more curb spots, a faster unload program, and a medium carpool incentive at Del Norte.

metrics.label: Resident approval
metrics.note: Share of 500 AI residents who approve (deterministic from their personal time and cost changes; range is a bootstrap over residents). No baseline value.
